annotations.title: Prepare a FirmLedger advertising checkout link

description: Does NOT charge anything. Checks that the listing belongs to this account and is approved, then returns a personal link to FirmLedger's own checkout for the chosen Sponsored-placement package. The user reviews and pays there themselves; you can never complete or confirm a payment. If the user says "yes, do it", give them the link again.

listing.description: One of the user's own approved listings (see get_my_listings or list_ad_packages).

package.description: The package id from list_ad_packages (or its exact name).

name: prepare_advertising
